title: oncidium volubile
intro: Oncidium volubile, commonly known as the 'Bowing Oncidium', is a species of orchid that belongs to the Oncidiinae subtribe. This plant is known for its unique, curved inflorescence and delicate white flowers with yellow markings. The health benefits of Oncidium volubile include its potential to reduce stress and promote relaxation due to its calming properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
